root_cause.text: In btrfs sub-group space_info cleanup, `check_removing_space_info()` directly calls `kfree()` on `space_info->sub_group[]` elements without first calling `btrfs_sysfs_remove_space_info()` to properly release the associated kobject and its dynamically allocated name, causing a memory leak of the kobject name.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `kfree(space_info->sub_group[i]);` with `btrfs_sysfs_remove_space_info(space_info->sub_group[i]);`. The commit message states that `kobject_init_and_add()` is called during creation (via `btrfs_sysfs_add_space_info_type()`) but `kobject_put()` is not called during removal, leading to the leak of `kobj->name` objects as shown by kmemleak.
